missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Детство' is a neuter noun in the nominative as the subject after 'было'. 'Счастливое' is the agreeing neuter adjective and 'у меня' shows whose childhood.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Детство' is the accusative direct object of 'вспоминает'; neuter nouns share nominative and accusative forms. 'Своё' agrees and 'часто' adds frequency.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Детства' is the genitive form required by 'из', expressing origin in time. 'Моего' agrees in the neuter genitive and 'игрушки' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Dative after adjective. 'Детству' is the dative form governed by 'верен'. 'Своему' agrees in the neuter dative, and 'он' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after verb. 'Детством' is instrumental because 'гордиться' governs the instrumental case. 'Своим счастливым' agrees in the neuter instrumental and 'он' is the subject.

missions.phrase: В детстве я жил у бабушки.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of time. 'В детстве' uses the prepositional form 'детстве' after 'в' to mean during childhood. 'Я' is the subject of 'жил' and 'у бабушки' shows location.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Детство' is the neuter nominative subject of 'пролетело', which agrees in neuter gender. 'Очень быстро' adds the manner of its passing.
Strategic focus: Dative after participle. 'Детству' is the dative form governed by 'посвящена'. 'Далёкому' agrees in the neuter dative, and 'книга' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Детство' is the neuter nominative subject equated with 'время'. 'Самое счастливое' forms the superlative agreeing with 'время'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Детство' is the accusative object of 'напоминает'. 'Мне' is the dative experiencer and 'запах хлеба' is the nominative subject doing the reminding.
